class.name: WorldExclusion3D
class.brief_description: A keep-out area for procedural plants, grass and stones.
class.description: Keeps the procedural fields out of hand-placed content, like PCG Biome Core's exclusion volumes and paths. A closed curve is an area, an open curve a track of [member width], and no curve a box of [member size]; the node's rotation and scale apply. Moving or editing it announces the old and new bounds through [signal WorldContracts.exclusions_changed], and the fields place only that ground again.

method.name: get_keep_out_at
method.description: How strongly the area keeps content out at [param position]: 1 inside, 0 outside, softened over [member fade].

members.member: With a curve: [code]true[/code] makes it an area, [code]false[/code] a track of [member width].
The width in metres over which the keep-out softens at the edge.
What it keeps out: plants ([constant KIND_PLANTS]), grass ([constant KIND_GRASS]) and stones ([constant KIND_ROCKS]).
The box's size in metres, used when the node has no curve.
A track's width in metres (an open curve).
